beforeActionResult.before: Forge Armor Master Rank grid has set names in rows and different body-part shapes in columns. Shara Ishvalda beta-plus pieces are selected.
beforeActionResult.action: Highlighted selection moves between chest/waist/legs/arms/head armor parts.
beforeActionResult.result: The center item name/model and right equipment information/skills change to the selected piece. This is browsing/preview, not completed crafting.

beforeActionResult.before: Individual part details are shown while the character retains its previous colorful worn appearance.
beforeActionResult.action: View switches to the whole Shara Ishvalda alpha-plus set and its item list.
beforeActionResult.result: The whole-set preview visibly changes the character armor and shows aggregate set information. The currency remains unchanged, so do not claim a purchase or permanent equip was completed.

beforeActionResult.action: Selection moves to Kirin beta-plus set, then a head and a leg armor piece.
beforeActionResult.result: Kirin appearance and piece-specific names/materials/skills replace the prior details.
